stem.text: It is possible for a bacterium to synthesise a eukaryotic protein.
This involves introducing a eukaryotic gene into the bacterial DNA, which can be translated.
What explains why a bacterial cell can produce a eukaryotic protein but cannot produce a eukaryotic glycoprotein?

B.text: Bacteria do not have a nuclear envelope.

C.text: Bacteria do not have Golgi bodies.
